limits: USD covers reachable workflow conversations plus usage-bearing validator verdicts. Separately launched isolated provider probes and failed validator attempts without usage are not included.
Durations come from workflow event envelopes and include in-turn tool/validation waits; they are not CPU or model inference time.
Extractor hung flags are contradicted by primary transcript activity and explicit background waits.
Cost and tokens for Codex are estimates where adapters report estimates. Claude window metrics are computed only from measurable implementer completion records.
Issue appearances and tool error flags are not unique defects or avoidable waste.
